reveals.title: Failure 1: platform risk
reveals.body: Pricing or limits can change · Integrations can break overnight · Own workflows where possible

risk.title: You're building on someone else's tool.
risk.body: n8n or Make can change pricing, limits, or terms; a connected app can break its integration overnight.

A connected app can break its integration overnight

reveals.title: Own your workflows where you can
reveals.body: never let one client's whole system hang on a single fragile link

reveals.title: Failure 2: commoditization
reveals.body: Simple automations get easy · Judgment-heavy work stays durable · Payroll, reconciliation, shipping

risk.title: The simplest automations will be DIY'd.
risk.body: The durable work is judgment-heavy, not two-step. The messy integrations stay yours.

reveals.title: Payroll · reconciliation · order → fulfillment
reveals.body: nobody wakes up wanting to do those — that's exactly why they're durable
